title: Kis Tarha Madina Jaaye Hum Sakina
body:
Is Aandhere Ghar Me Tujhku Codhkar Sakina
<<MINI>>
Kis Tarha Madina Jaaye Hum Sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
Sona Sona Sa Laagenga Tere Bin Madina
<<MINI>>
Kis Tarha Madina Jaaye Hum Sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
1.Qaid-e-Ghum Se Meri Jaan Qafila Rehha Howa
Jiska Intezar Tha Tujhe Wo Waqt Aagaya
Aansuo Ki Chao Me Ghamou Ki Hai Ameena
<<MINI>>
Kis Tarha Madina Jaaye Hum Sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
2.Kaise Denge Shah-e-Deen Ku Teri Mout Ki Khabar
Kaanp Uthta Hai Kaleja Bus Yeh Sonch Sonch Kar
Aaraha Hai Aj Rukh Pe Mout Ka Pasina
<<MINI>>
Kis Tarha Madina Jaaye Hum Sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
3.Teri Yaad Me Hamesha Aashke Ghum Bahaenge
Tujhpe Jo Sitam Howe Hai Kaisa Bhool Payenge
Bin Tere Azaab-e-Jaan Hai Hamara Jeena
<<MINI>>
Kis Tarha Madina Jaaye Hum Sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
4.Muntazir Aamariyan Hai Kya Nahin Yeh Hosh Hai
Maa Bularahi Hai Tujhku Aur Tu Khamosh Hai
Jaanlewa Hai Teri Khamoshi Yeh Sakina
<<MINI>>
Kis Tarha Madina Jaaye Hum Sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
5.Jo Lutey They Karbala Me Wo Aasase Milgaye
Hum Tujhe Pehnaye They Jo Goshware Milgaye
Dekh Kar Teri Rida Ku Phath Raha Hai Seena
<<MINI>>
Kis Tarha Madina Jaaye Hum Sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
6.Zainab-e-Hazeen Ke Shad Qaid Me Yeh Bain They
Kis Tarha Se Aaye Sakina Ab Teri Phuphi Jiye
Teri Mout Ne Hamare Dil Ka Chain Cheena
<<MINI>>
Kis Tarha Madina Jaaye Hum Sakina
